content: This push towards greener logistics requires significant investment and further drives the trend of optimizing existing fleets to ensure they meet environmental compliance while maintaining operational viability. Furthermore, global logistical trends, such as fluctuating truckload rates and broader supply chain disruptions, exert indirect pressures on South African operations [12] . The ongoing impact of these regional and global logistics developments continues to shape the strategic priorities of firms operating in South Africa [25] . Although retrospective insights into specific policies, stakeholder actions, or measurable outcomes achieved between 2020 and 2024 are somewhat limited in the analyzed literature, the forward-looking consensus points toward a highly competitive environment predicated on amplified bulk logistics capabilities [21] . Impact of Commodity Price Trends on Transport Needs Understanding the intricate dynamics of commodity transport demand requires a comprehensive analysis of various market signals and their cascading effects on logistics requirements. The volatility of commodity prices further complicates the transportation landscape.
